name: Award
definition: A prize or honor given for achievement.

name: Biological Taxon
definition: A group of biological organisms, such as a species, genus, or family.

name: Chemical Substance
definition: A chemical compound, molecule, protein, or drug.

name: Concept
definition: An abstract idea, metric, or general notion.

name: Creative Work
definition: A produced work of art or entertainment, such as a film, television show, book, song, or game.

name: Currency
definition: A system of money or monetary symbol.

name: Demographic Group
definition: A group of people defined by shared characteristics such as ethnicity, nationality, or religion.

name: Deity
definition: A supernatural being considered divine or sacred.

name: Event
definition: A specific occurrence or happening in time, such as a competition, election, war, or ceremony.

name: Language
definition: A system of communication used by a community.

name: Legislation
definition: A law or act passed by a legislative body.

name: Location
definition: A geographical entity, physical structure, or infrastructure, including countries, cities, buildings, and natural features.

name: Organization
definition: A group of people, such as a company, institution, government body, political party, or sports team.

name: Product
definition: A manufactured item, vehicle, weapon, or software.
